questions.text: Where is Nurgul Abenova from, and what does she study?
questions.hint: "My name is Nurgul Abenova. I am from Taraz. I study Biology at WKU."

questions.text: The WKU cafeteria closes at 9:00 pm every day.
questions.hint: "It is open every day from 7:00 am to 8:00 pm."

questions.text: Which special traditional dish is served every Friday at the WKU cafeteria?
questions.hint: "On Fridays, the cafeteria serves something very special: beshbarmak!"

questions.text: A full lunch at the WKU cafeteria costs only ___ tenge.
questions.hint: "A full lunch costs only 600 tenge, which is very affordable for a student."

questions.text: What does Ruslan bring from the market every Sunday?
questions.hint: "He brings some fruit from the market every Sunday — some apples, some bananas, or some grapes."

questions.text: There is a coffee machine near the entrance of the WKU cafeteria.
questions.hint: "There is a small coffee machine near the entrance — you can get some espresso or some cappuccino for 200 tenge."

questions.text: Why doesn't Ruslan buy any chips or biscuits from the student shop?
opts: He tries to avoid unhealthy snacks.
questions.correct: He tries to avoid unhealthy snacks.
questions.hint: "He never buys any chips or any sweet biscuits from the student shop."

questions.text: How much does a coffee from the machine cost?
questions.hint: "You can get some espresso or some cappuccino for 200 tenge."

questions.text: Which dish does Ruslan choose for lunch?
questions.hint: "Pasta with vegetables — perfect for me!" — Ruslan does not want any meat.

questions.text: The chicken soup in the cafeteria today is very spicy.
questions.hint: "No, it's very mild. No chilli, no pepper. Everyone can eat it!" — Nurgul.

questions.text: Why does Ruslan choose water instead of compote?
opts: Compote is too sweet for him.
questions.correct: Compote is too sweet for him.
questions.hint: "Just some water for me — compote is too sweet. I prefer something plain." — Ruslan.

questions.text: Nurgul spots some fresh ___ near the counter — she loves them!
questions.hint: "Yes — some fresh white bread at the counter. And — wait — some baursaks too!" — Nurgul.

questions.text: Nurgul misses her grandmother's samsa from Taraz.
questions.hint: It is RUSLAN who misses his grandmother's samsa from SEMEY. Nurgul misses her mother's plov.

questions.text: What ingredients does Nurgul mention in her mother's plov?
questions.hint: "My mother's plov — with some carrots, some raisins, and some lamb. Heavenly!" — Nurgul.

questions.text: There is ___ fresh beshbarmak on the menu today — it's Friday!
questions.hint: Positive sentence (+) → some. "There is SOME beshbarmak today."

questions.text: "I have any money — let me pay for lunch" is correct English.
questions.hint: Positive sentence → some! "I have SOME money." ANY is only for negatives and questions.

questions.text: ___ water does Nurgul drink every day? — About six glasses.
questions.hint: Water = uncountable → How MUCH water. (You cannot say "1 water, 2 waters".)

questions.text: Ruslan offers food to Nurgul. Which sentence is correct?
questions.hint: Offers use SOME: "Would you like SOME baursaks?" — not any.

questions.text: I don't want ___ spicy food today.
questions.hint: Negative sentence (don't want) → any. "I don't want ANY spicy food."

questions.text: ___ does lunch cost? — 600 tenge.
questions.hint: Money/price = uncountable → How MUCH does it cost?

questions.text: "How much baursaks are there?" is correct English.
questions.hint: Baursaks = countable (1 baursak, 2 baursaks) → "How MANY baursaks are there?"

questions.text: "Is there ___ compote left?" — "Yes, I got some for you!"
questions.hint: Question (?) → any. "Is there ANY compote left?"

questions.text: What is beshbarmak?
opts: A steamed dumpling filled with meat
The national Kazakh dish of flat noodles with boiled meat and rich broth
A rice dish with carrots and lamb
questions.correct: The national Kazakh dish of flat noodles with boiled meat and rich broth
questions.hint: "The most famous traditional Kazakh dish — large flat noodles with tender boiled meat and rich broth."

questions.text: Baursaks are ___ in oil until they are golden and crispy outside.
questions.hint: Fry = жарить. Baursaks are fried (not boiled or steamed).

questions.text: What does "nutritious" mean?
opts: containing many substances your body needs to stay healthy
questions.correct: containing many substances your body needs to stay healthy
questions.hint: "Eating nutritious food helps Nurgul concentrate in her Biology lectures."

questions.text: "Mild" food is very spicy and burns your mouth.
questions.hint: Mild = мягкий/нежгучий — NOT spicy. "The soup is very mild — no chilli, no pepper."

questions.text: What is "shurpa"?
opts: A baked pastry filled with meat
A rich Kazakh soup made with lamb and vegetables
questions.correct: A rich Kazakh soup made with lamb and vegetables
questions.hint: Shurpa = шурпа — "a rich, hearty Kazakh soup made with lamb and vegetables."

questions.text: What does "affordable" describe?
opts: cheap enough for most people to buy
very rare and hard to find
questions.correct: cheap enough for most people to buy
questions.hint: "A full lunch costs only 600 tenge — very affordable for a student!"

questions.text: Ruslan brought some ___ from the market — about thirty of them! They shared them between lectures.
questions.hint: From the reading: "Ruslan had some grapes from the market... About thirty! We shared them..."

questions.text: What is "manty"?
opts: large steamed dumplings filled with minced meat and onion
questions.correct: large steamed dumplings filled with minced meat and onion
questions.hint: Manty = манты — "large steamed dumplings filled with minced meat and onion."
